name: Collaborator on the Simple profile, 10% flat withholding
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: A service-contract collaborator (CTV) paid 15,000,000 for a full month.
The entity's policy taxes the Simple profile as 'flat_withholding'; the person is a resident, so the method is the withholding for people without a labour contract of three months or more.
The seeded rate is 10% and the per-payment threshold 2,000,000; the payment is above it and there is no form 08/CK-TNCN on file, so tax is withheld.
PIT = 10% x 15,000,000 = 1,500,000. No personal or dependent deduction applies to flat withholding.
No insurance and no union on the Simple profile.
